items.q: I used to go to the YMCA on 135th Street, and this fellow was an old time performer... So we got to talking.

ctx.x: the last recording, received letters wanting to know could did we (unintelligible) know anything about any of his relatives. And we started searching around (unintelligible) I said, well, anybody should know, it would be (unintelligible) Wellman Brown, Sidney Bechet or Albert Nicholas, and they were in Europe. Bechet and Albert, they was in Paris then.

So Brod Brode was still in New York, a bunch of us, so they came to get us, one thing, said, I know he had some sisters in New Orleans, that when this guy Lomax wrote worked his book, that he had his sister's name in there and the place where Jelly Roll was born. No, sometime he came up, a kind of a conflict, because I used to go to the YMCA on 135th Street, and this fellow was an old time performer. He was very light, very good performing singer. So we got to talking. He said, listen, do you know where Jelly…
